entries.subject: Placement

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.348 +/- 0.011 solar radii from Christiansen et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-384 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..244C/abstract). Mass 0.33 +/- 0.009 solar masses from Christiansen et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-384 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..244C/abstract). Temperature 3623 +/- 138 K from Christiansen et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-384 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,623 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffca92. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,623 K and log g 4.87 (u1 0.376, u2 0.380): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
